lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are distributed in roughly vertical alignments across the central flank. The spatial arrangement exhibits a quasi-regular grid pattern with a cluster of distinct local maxima posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs, particularly visible in the mid-section where they form established grid-like nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-reflecting upper pixels and a distinct shadow-line below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal remora fish attached to the lower lateral flank, appearing as elongated high-intensity features against the shark's body.
